summary: Narrow street with houses 4-9 m from kerb all along; no clear section.
reasons: Dwellings within 10 m along whole kerb

best_section.where: top end near the corner junction, west side

drivers.seclusion: Mapped houses 4-9 m from the kerb at 2-115 m; another at 5 m at 115 m. Nearest other home 26 m at the top, but the 115 m house is within 10 m of its start.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed narrow street; cars park on both sides, room for one van beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; motorway is across the houses to the west.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street, but residents overlook it closely.

sun_shade: Mixed tree canopy; shade from the east side gardens in the morning.
